title: mcplite 0.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-10-20 Adds stateless MCP 2026-07-28 support retaining initialize-based MCP 2024-11-05, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25. Modern discovery, tool listing, tool calls work without initialization; legacy ping behavior preserved, modern ping unsupported. Adds server/discover deterministic four-version ordering. Successful modern results include canonical server identity resultType = "complete"; discovery tool-list results include public cache hints. Expands tool schemas protocol-native results. Complete object-root input schemas retain JSON Schema 2020-12 keywords; modern clients can receive supported output-schema roots JSON structured-content shapes, older protocols receive compatible projections fallback content. Adds payload options mcplite.json.null, mcplite.json.na, mcplite.json.auto_unbox, preserving published defaults fixed protocol metadata encoding. See help("mcplite-results") configuration details. Restores empty structured-root lists {} removes unreleased scalar-NA coercion favor jsonlite’s class-specific mappings.

title: mcplite 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-08-03 First release lightweight, tools-Model Context Protocol (MCP) server standard input output (stdio), supporting MCP lifecycle, ping, tools/list, tools/call. Supports protocol versions 2024-11-05, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25. Provides native tool JSON Schema helpers, optional interoperability compatible ellmer tool definitions. Adds explicit protocol-native tool results tool_result() content_text(), content_image(), content_audio(), content_resource_link(), content_resource() constructors. Results may contain ordered mixed content, structured content, annotations, metadata ordinary R return values retain existing text conversion. Adds object-shaped output_schema support tool(). Tool definitions results follow negotiated MCP version: structured output, output schemas, audio, resource links, content metadata available 2025-06-18 later, compatible fallback contained tool errors 2024-11-05. Handles protocol negotiation, request validation, JSON-RPC errors, MCP tool-call errors keeping stdio protocol stream usable. Automatically traces every envelope-valid MCP operation one OpenTelemetry server span, keeping tool-authored child spans optional. Standard otel otelsdk configuration owns provider exporter selection, remote W3C parent context accepted params._meta, request tool content captured default. Stdio servers must use stderr remote exporter stdout reserved MCP messages; exporter configured, tracing effective -op.
